messages:
anya: Quick update — we are publishing the Private autoscale + cost/SLA playbook to the docs site right now. This is aimed at Dedicated + Private customers who want predictable latency and clearer unit economics when autoscaling is enabled. https://redwood.docs/internal/private-autoscale-playbook :tada:

cj: Nice. Does this change the billing model for burst capacity? I saw a note in the draft.

anya: Short answer: no pricing change today. The playbook clarifies how burst pools are applied and recommends cost controls (quota + soft limits). We'll propose a pricing change separately if we need to make reserved vs burst different. See the "billing notes" section in the doc.

elaine: Adding the ops runbook for on-prem teams — adjust this before we send to customers: the healthcheck timeout recommendation needs to be lowered for older agents.

anya: Good catch. @elaine can you paste the suggested values?

elaine: Suggested snippet:

```
autoscale:
  target_rps: 120
  cooldown_seconds: 45
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 20
  healthcheck_timeout_seconds: 8  # older agents need shorter timeout
```

cj: We should also add a note about cache priming and KV cache invalidation on scale-down. Team saw a 15% latency spike when scale-from-zero happened in beta.

marco: Customer comms question — do we have an FAQ and a suggested email for customers migrating from reserved-only to autoscale? I can draft if product approves.

anya: Yes — there's an "email template" appendix. Please hold off until @product-review signs off; aiming for internal review by EOD.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: docs/private/autoscale-playbook v1.0 -> staging (build 20260323.45)

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook updated: private_autoscale_incident.md (added scale-down checklist) by elaine

cj: For Dedicated capacity, SLA paragraph updated: 99.9% latency SLO applies when configured with min_replicas >= 2. Otherwise see best-effort fallback. Make sure support knows to triage using the new route tag `private-autoscale`.

anya: Action items: 1) @elaine update healthcheck/ops snippets (done), 2) @cj add KV-cache note + route tag to support playbook, 3) @marco hold email draft until product approves. I'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow at 10am PT to review rollout checklist. :calendar:

marco: Ack, I'll draft and assign to product-review channel.

elaine: Also adding a short checklist for customers to validate L7 LB timeouts — many on-prem setups default to 60s which kills longer generation sessions.

anya: Thanks all. If you spot anything else, drop comments on the doc. Goal: GA reader-ready by EOD tomorrow. :rocket:
